scope: Real single-node GPU workflow samples; not a proof of complete public-API, hardware, workload or performance equivalence.
reference_use: Separate black-box execution of independently authored workflows, with per-process module-origin checks. No upstream unit tests run or copied.

core.details: Single GPU and two-GPU DDP/FSDP1/FSDP2 in FP32/FP16/BF16, plus four-GPU DDP/FSDP2 BF16; train, accumulation, tail metrics, scaler overflow, Adam/StepLR, exact checkpoint continuation and native model export.

memory.details: CUDA/CPU/disk offload, multi-GPU tied weights, auto mapping, meta bin/safetensors loading, FP16/BF16 layer casting, real bitsandbytes 4/8-bit resident/meta/disk inference.

fp8_ao.details: One and two GPUs; emulate=False, real aten::_scaled_mm (18 calls/rank during continuation), finite nonzero gradients, fresh-process checkpoint recovery. This suite selects fp8_ao rows only; historical DeepSpeed differences in this job are superseded by jobs 8526282/8526283.

parallel.details: Four-GPU DP2 x TP2 and two-GPU CP; both implementations verify full parameter updates against independent dense PyTorch models. TP verifies checkpoint continuation; CP records FlashAttention forward/backward and actual all-to-all collectives. Cross-implementation reported summaries/losses match, but no full-parameter cross-implementation parity claim is made.

deepspeed_standard.details: ZeRO2/3 with standard Accelerator.accumulate, native PyTorch StepLR or DeepSpeed WarmupLR, plus ZeRO2 five-microbatch tail flush. Fresh save/resume processes. Six (or five-tail) microbatches produce three updates.

deepspeed_defaults.details: ZeRO2/3 behavior without Accelerator.accumulate: default sync state updates on every backward, reproducing the reference. Six microbatches produce six updates; not the standard accumulation recipe.

runtime_fixes.problem: Optimizer wrapper retained stale param_groups/state/defaults after distributed checkpoint restoration.
runtime_fixes.change: Delegate current state to the underlying optimizer instead of caching dictionary references.

runtime_fixes.problem: FSDP2 context-parallel ranks did not reduce gradients across the CP dimension.
runtime_fixes.change: Use the joint dp_shard x cp mesh for FSDP gradient reduction, retaining the replication dimension.

runtime_fixes.problem: DeepSpeed standard accumulation called unsupported no_sync; engine update boundaries and scheduler ownership differed from the reference.
runtime_fixes.change: Let GradientState control engine boundaries, skip DeepSpeed no_sync, and leave ordinary PyTorch schedulers under AcceleratedScheduler while config-defined schedulers remain engine-owned.

historical_failures.details: TP checkpoint LR reference was stale; CP parameter replicas diverged. Superseded by 8526216.

historical_failures.classification: cross-implementation numerical mismatch despite independent train/resume success
historical_failures.details: DeepSpeed update counts and learning rates differed; full tensor comparison exposed the mismatch. Superseded by 8526282/8526283.
Standard DeepSpeed accumulation entered engine.no_sync, which ZeRO gradient partitioning rejects. Superseded by 8526282.

Missing real CUDA toolkit, different public hook/config entry points, string path requirements and unsupported TP-only FSDP topology. Fixed with official CUDA components and common public API fixtures, then rerun.

remaining_unverified: DeepSpeed Ulysses, CPU/NVMe offload, other ZeRO/optimizer configurations
Full TP/CP/SP combinations, large pretrained-model workloads and performance

evidence.format: JSON and text logs collected; tensor/checkpoint binaries remain in the shared raw directory. Per-run source hashes and all module origins are retained.
